category: operator precedence slip in a padding calculation; text table formatter across two packages
issue: Table headings are misplaced and the borders stop lining up. In a table whose columns come out 5 and 3 wide, the '+-------+-----+' rules are 15 characters long but the heading row prints 17, with the heading text jammed up against the right-hand edge of its cell instead of sitting in the middle of it. Body rows are fine, and so is anything flush left or flush right; the trouble only shows up where a value is meant to sit in the middle of its field, and it gets worse the wider the field is. The column widths themselves are worked out correctly.
